=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the man in a Facebook photograph posted 10 May 2026. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/tony.maravola). The uncropped original is a sleeping man with a dog on his head; the dog stays in Photographs. Lives South Elgin, Illinois; Gurnee is nearby. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Tony Maravola portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Tony Maravola Facebook portrait.jpg]].
